title: A satire site labels every page for people and agents
description:
Requested by Humorus (https://github.com/AnthusAI/Humorus), the satire publications that run a second, very different newsroom on Papyrus. Humorus issue: HUM-6050a9.

A site-level satire setting puts a visible label on pages and a statement in the Markdown versions, feeds, structured data, llms.txt and share previews. Sites without the setting are unchanged.
